name: VAE Encode Video
description: Turns a video into a latent with the model's VAE, for a Sampler to redraw from (video to video). The video is fitted to the clip the model will make: the rate is resampled, the picture is scaled to cover the size and cut from the middle, and the length is cut to 4 n + 1 frames from the start. Trim the video first to pick the part.

inputs.name: frames
inputs.label: Frames
inputs.description: How many frames to take from the start; fewer if the video is shorter. Wan makes 4 n + 1 frames (33, 81), so another count is cut to one.

inputs.name: fps
inputs.label: Frames per second
inputs.description: The rate the clip is resampled to. Wan 2.1 and 2.2 14B are made for 16, Wan 2.2 5B for 24.

inputs.name: width
inputs.label: Width
inputs.description: Unset: the video's width in steps of 16.

inputs.name: height
inputs.label: Height
inputs.description: Unset: the video's height in steps of 16.
